servicesPage.title: Complete Healthcare Solutions
servicesPage.subtitle: MedEm provides a full spectrum of medical services. Whether it's a routine consultation or a critical emergency, we're equipped to handle it.

aboutPage.title: Redefining access to critical healthcare.
aboutPage.description: MedEm was founded on a simple but powerful premise: no one should have to wait for life-saving medical attention. By bridging the gap between advanced technology and highly vetted medical professionals, we have built a seamless ecosystem that dispatches ambulances, connects patients with doctors, and delivers essential medicines, all within minutes.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.p1: MedEm is a digital-first healthcare platform built for real-world urgency. We combine emergency logistics, doctor networks, diagnostics, and medicine fulfillment into one coordinated experience so patients do not need to navigate fragmented systems during stressful moments.
whoWeAre.p2: Our team includes clinicians, operations specialists, and technology engineers focused on one outcome: making high-quality care faster, safer, and easier to access for every household.
